name: RPG Item Shop
description: A cozy pixel-game shop: starred items are Legendary, gift-givers Loot what they buy, and Smudge the soot sprite picks gifts.

mascot.name: Smudge
mascot.idle: Smudge, a fuzzy little soot sprite, looking up
mascot.happy: Smudge, a fuzzy little soot sprite, beaming
mascot.sad: Smudge, a fuzzy little soot sprite, sweating nervously

text.title: Wishlist Item Shop
text.welcome: Welcome, traveler! Everything on these shelves is on my wishlist. Gold-star items are legendary: the ones I want most. Tap the {i} on a photo for sizes, colors and notes.
text.footer: save point reached. generated from a spreadsheet.
text.empty.title: The shelves are empty
text.lootError: {mascot} couldn't reach the loot log. Check your connection and try again.
text.planner.idle: Psst! Tell me your budget and I will dig through the shop for the best loot.
text.planner.emptySub: {mascot} only digs through items the shop filters are showing.
text.planner.emptySubClaims: {mascot} only digs through items the shop filters are showing, and skips anything already looted.
text.planner.none: Eep! Nothing fits under {budget} once I save some for tax and shipping. More gold, or fewer filters?
text.planner.onlyCard: Nothing on the shelves fits, but a {amount} {name} does!
text.planner.squeezed: Squeezed the most out of your gold.
text.planner.bufferHint: {mascot} sets aside about {pct}% of your budget as a rough guess for tax and shipping. Real costs vary by shop and location, so check the total at checkout.
text.planner.maxBudget: {mascot} can only count up to {amount} at a time.
text.planner.claimHint: Bought one? Hit Loot on its card so nobody doubles up.
text.planner.undone: Phew, un-looted! It is back on the shelf.
text.error.title: The shop is closed
text.error.line: Eep! I could not reach the spreadsheet. Try refreshing in a minute?
text.setup.line: Eep! This shop has no shelves yet. Someone needs to connect a spreadsheet.
